title: Fairspec testsuite test file
description: An array of groups. A group fixes the subject of an operation; each of its tests varies only the data and states the outcome. The layout follows JSON-Schema-Test-Suite.

description.description: What the group covers; unique within the file

comment.description: Context for maintainers; never read by a runner

specification.description: Links to the spec sections the group exercises

format.description: File extension the data is written with

inline.description: Pass the test's data to the resource as inline data instead of writing a file

query.description: SQL run against the loaded table as `self` for table-query, or against each resource by name for dataset-query

dataset.description: Dataset descriptor written as dataset.json; each resource's data names a key of the test's data

options.description: Options of the operation, with the camelCase keys the TypeScript API uses

description.description: What the test checks; unique within the group

data.description: The file content: exact text, base64 bytes, JSON rows, an inline JSON value, or for a dataset one entry per file name

valid.description: Expected `valid` of the report, for validate operations

errors.description: Expected `errors` of the report, compared exactly and in order

expected.description: Expected result of an infer, describe or load operation

throws.description: The operation is expected to raise
